name: agy-token-monitor
description: Live token tracker, compression monitor, and automatic context handoff for Google Antigravity

antigravity.tokenMonitor.handoffTarget.description: Token threshold to trigger handoff recommendation (0 to disable).

antigravity.tokenMonitor.enableWarningCo.description: Show color-coded warnings (yellow/red) when nearing handoff target or internal compression.

antigravity.tokenMonitor.compressionHead.description: Buffer tokens before compression milestone to trigger early yellow warning.
